response.original_title: 穹頂天眼－從格陵蘭看黑洞
response.overview: The black hole is one of the most mysterious celestial bodies. Does it really exist, or just live within theories? In the past century, the existence of black holes is one of the biggest mysteries in science. This film records the entire process of building an Arctic telescope by a global team to unveil the first image of black hole, a project that would advance the frontier of science exploration and our understanding of our universe in the context of Einstein's theory of relativity.
response.title: The Eye of Arctic- Imaging the black hole from Greenland
